title: WGA strike (2007-08)
note: Nov 5 2007 through Feb 12 2008 inclusive (100 days); writers returned to work Feb 13 2008. end = first day back.

title: WGA strike (2023)
note: Start: wgacontract2023.org/announcements/wga-on-strike: 'will begin on Tuesday, May 2, 2023 at 12:01 am PT'. End: 'end the strike as of 12:01 am PT/3:01 am ET on Wednesday, September 27th'. 148 days; end is exclusive.

title: SAG-AFTRA 2020 TV/Theatrical contracts expire
note: sagaftra.org: 'the previous TV/Theatrical contracts, which expired on June 30, 2023'.

title: SAG-AFTRA TV/Theatrical strike (2023)
note: sagaftra.org: 'The union called a strike beginning 12:01 a.m. July 14, which continued for 118 days until Nov. 9.' End is exclusive (suspended 12:01 a.m. Nov 9).

title: WGA members ratify 2023 MBA
note: wgacontract2023.org, Monday October 9, 2023: '99% of WGA members have voted in favor of ratifying the 2023 MBA.' Term Sep 25, 2023 through May 1, 2026.

title: SAG-AFTRA members ratify 2023 TV/Theatrical contracts
note: sagaftra.org, December 5, 2023: 'In national voting completed today, members of SAG-AFTRA ratified the 2023 TV/Theatrical Agreement' (78.33% yes). Effective retroactive to Nov 9, 2023.

title: IATSE members ratify 2024-2027 Hollywood Basic Agreement
note: iatse.net, July 18, 2024: 'members have overwhelmingly voted to ratify both the 2024-2027 Hollywood Basic Agreement and the 2024-2027 Area Standards Agreement, Thursday' (85.9% yes). In effect August 4, 2024.

title: WGA members ratify 2026 MBA (no strike)
note: wga.org, April 24, 2026: 'WGA members have ratified the 2026 MBA with 90.38% (4,282) voting in favor, and 9.62% (456) voting no.' Term May 2, 2026 through May 1, 2030.

title: WGA 2023 MBA expires (successor already ratified)
note: wgacontract2023.org: 'The term of the agreement is from September 25, 2023 through May 1, 2026.'

title: SAG-AFTRA members ratify 2026 TV/Theatrical contracts (no strike)
note: sagaftra.org, June 4, 2026: 'In national voting completed today, members of SAG-AFTRA ratified the 2026 TV/Theatrical Agreement' (91.42% yes). Tentative agreement May 2, 2026; National Board approved May 11.

title: SAG-AFTRA 2023 TV/Theatrical contracts expire (successor already ratified)
note: sagaftra.org: 'The agreement is effective retroactive to Nov. 9, 2023, and expires June 30, 2026.'

title: IATSE 2024 Hollywood Basic Agreement expires
note: iatse.net summary PDF, item 12: 'The term of the Agreement will be from August 1, 2024-July 31, 2027.'

title: WGA 2026 MBA expires
note: wga.org: term of the 2026 MBA is May 2, 2026 through May 1, 2030.

title: SAG-AFTRA 2026 TV/Theatrical contracts expire
note: sagaftra.org: 'The agreement is effective on July 1, 2026, and expires June 30, 2030.'
